canDoYue: 你識講頸鏈、手鏈、耳環同珍珠，仲識分清 this／these 同 pair／pearl。
canDoEn: Name a necklace, a bracelet, and a pair of pearl earrings, and keep this/these and pair/pearl apart.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: This necklace is beautiful, and it sits lightly on your neck.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢條頸鏈好靚，而且戴落好輕。
dialogue.say: This necklace is beautiful, and it sits lightly on your neck.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I like this bracelet, and the clasp is easy to open.
dialogue.glossYue: 我鍾意呢隻手鈪，個扣都易開。
dialogue.say: I like this [[bɹˈeɪslət.]], and the clasp is easy to open.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: We have a pair of pearl earrings, and they match this necklace.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋有一對珍珠耳環，同呢條頸鏈好襯。
dialogue.say: We have a pair [[əv]] pearl earrings, and they match this necklace.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: May I see these earrings, and the matching necklace too?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以睇吓呢對耳環，同埋套裝？
dialogue.say: May I see these earrings, and the matching necklace too?

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: Of course. This pair is beautiful, and I can show you the set.
dialogue.glossYue: 當然。呢對好靚，我可以畀你睇成套。
dialogue.say: [[əv kˈɔɹs.]] This pair is beautiful, and I can show you the set.

understand.prompt: This necklace is beautiful. 係講緊邊件？
understand.explain: necklace 係戴喺頸嘅。bracelet 先至係手鏈。

understand.prompt: A pair of earrings. 係幾多隻？
understand.explain: pair 係一對。呢啲耳環用 these。
一件用 this /ðɪs/。多過一件用 these /ðiz/。

chunks.pattern: This ___ is beautiful when you wear it out this evening.
chunks.example: This necklace is beautiful when you wear it out this evening.

chunks.pattern: I like this ___ because it sits well on the wrist.
chunks.example: I like this bracelet because it sits well on the wrist.

chunks.pattern: I would like a pair of ___ for a birthday gift.
chunks.example: I would like a pair of pearl earrings for a birthday gift.

chunks.pattern: May I see ___ before I decide on a gift?
chunks.example: May I see these earrings before I decide on a gift?

shadow.hint: We have a pair of pearl earrings.

build.promptYue: Tom 話 I like this bracelet. 你點接？
choices: We have a pair of pearl earrings.
build.explain: 接住佢鍾意嘅件，再講一對相關嘅耳環。

roleplay.intro: Tom 企喺櫃檯前。你講件名之前，等佢問完先答。

turns.expect: We have a pair of pearl earrings.
Of course. This pair is beautiful.

quiz.prompt: 客人講「I like this bracelet, and the clasp is easy to open.」，係咩意思？
客人講「Of course. This pair is beautiful, and I can show you the set.」，係咩意思？

sound.title: 一件同一對
sound.note: this /ðɪs/：短 /ɪ/，尾清 /s/，講一件。these /ðiz/：長 /i/，尾有聲 /z/，講呢啲。pair /pɛɹ/ 係「一對」，嘴開少少。pearl /pɝl/ 係「珍珠」，舌尖向上卷，唔好掂到上顎。bracelet 重音喺第一節，尾 /t/ 要收住。earring 都係第一節重讀。
